lines: Three minutes to ten at night.
cold
A runner came down the Concord trench with one number on a scrap of paper. One hundred.
cold2
This is Front News. Day three.
ident
All evening the Concord had been counting new soldiers.
ridge
By ten at night it was ninety-four for the Hegemony, and one hundred for the Concord.
ridge1
The hundredth man was a cook, Lucien Jro. With him, Verdel Ridge belonged to the Concord.
ridge2
Within the hour, the guns on the ridge turned toward the Hegemony.
guns
All night, the shells came down on the Hegemony line.
guns2
Fifteen men were hit in the first night. The wire in front of them was torn to shreds.
guns3
In the hospital dugout, the surgeon worked on Bram Yoollyfox until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.
ward
Lucien Jewnipers slipped away in the night. The orderly who sat with him said he was not afraid.
ward2
Nils Wolfmananton died with a rosary of rough beads in his hand.
ward3
The Hegemony answered the only way it could. Edmund Potato raised his rifle.
shot
Henrik Eccentricred of the Concord fell, and never moved again.
shot2
Day three gave the war its first dead. Five for the Hegemony. One for the Concord.
dead
Then it rained from dusk to dawn. The trenches filled with water, and with men.
rain
Seventy-two new soldiers came up the line. The Hegemony now held one hundred and eighteen. The Concord, one hundred and twenty.
rain2
And a new race began at once. Hill 304.
hill
By morning, the Hegemony led, twenty-four to twenty.
hill2
This was Front News. Next time: the guns do not stop.
out
